== Summary ==
Lossless composition of the official source image with its original PDF transparency mask for [[Depa Billaba (V) (Errata 2)]]. Source: [[:File:Virtual-Set-7-September-2023.pdf]], page 2, image xref 10, mask xref 9. The original image bytes are preserved at [[:File:V7-L-depabillaba-Set 7-September-2023-partial-source.jpeg]]; the complete original PDF retains both image and mask. PDF SHA-256 <code>597c96306746c8958d56283651afdf714ff23b88e847e86bbc39e319c578e363</code>; embedded JPEG SHA-256 <code>17e17bc978a3fcfc5b77d85caf3ada9e45086378a02e77c8bab65d265bd0611d</code>; original mask stream SHA-256 <code>7516c43f556f5b69ccaf94e083534b058424c577734b3ebff8686ac81145ed74</code>. Printed edition: September 2023. No exact first-publication day established. Lucasfilm Ltd.; original slip published by the Players Committee.
